title: Figure 24. HFGW Com Space Application Development Roadmap, Estimated Timeline (2009-2050)
description: Gantt-style chart titled "GW Communications Development Timeline Estimate" spanning decades 201X to 204X (years 2009-2050), with program milestones (Exp R&D Go-Ahead, Prototype Go-Ahead, Device Design, EMD Bid, Production Award, Space System Go-Ahead, 1st Space Delivery). Bars show Experimental Research to 2020, Prototype Development to 2025, Device Development to 2035, Applications Development to 2040, and Applications Production with "Interplanetary Upgrade / Delivery". Page is section "4.1 Developmental Roadmap".
